purpose: Teach: 身勝手/行き届い/正気/脱帽/つまっ/のぞく/使いこなす/築き上げ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、身勝手な振る舞いはお父さんに迷惑をかけるわよ
lines.en: Sho, when you act selfishly like that, it puts your father in a difficult position.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but not unkind. Steady, clear. A correction delivered gently but with the weight of a parent who knows what matters. Eyes level, shoulders calm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お家の隅々まで掃除が行き届いてるね
lines.en: Mom, our whole house is so clean and neat, isn't it?
lines.style: Bright, curious observation. Child's wonder at noticing something good. Open and pleased, like he's just realized something true. Small wonder in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが疲れて、正気を保つのも大変よ
lines.en: Sho, your father works so hard just to keep himself steady through the day.
lines.style: Soft, reflective. Not complaining — explaining something important quietly. A pause before the thought, like she's choosing her words with care. Warm underneath the tiredness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの努力には脱帽だよ
lines.en: Mom, I really admire how hard Dad tries.
lines.style: Sincere and unhurried. A child speaking something he's noticed and thought about. Quiet respect in his voice. No performance — just what he means.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、引き出しが書類でつまってるから整理しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, these drawers are full of papers. Let's organize them together, shall we?
lines.style: Practical, gentle redirect. The tone of someone moving forward with quiet purpose. Inviting him into the task rather than making it a chore. Warm but focused.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがお部屋をのぞくよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad is peeking into my room again.
lines.style: Gentle observation, not complaint. The small noticing tone a quiet child uses when he's watching. Neither worried nor dismissive — just aware. A soft, observant murmur.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが新しい機械を使いこなすまで時間がかかるわね
lines.en: Sho, it takes your father a while to get the hang of new things, you know?
lines.style: Patient, understanding. Not excusing — explaining. A mother's acceptance of her husband's pace. Slight warmth on the 'you know,' like she's sharing a small truth with her son. Steady tempo.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが家族の絆を築き上げて下さってるよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad has worked so hard to bring our family closer together.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine. A child speaking a realized truth. Deep sincerity without dramatics. Slow, thoughtful pace. The words land because he means them completely.
